description: This file defines a Lua module exporting a function 'Layout' that constructs an HTML layout using a custom 'luax' function for HTML element creation. It includes components like Head and SocialButton, and generates a comprehensive webpage structure with header, navigation, main content, and footer.

methods.name: Layout
methods.description: Constructs and returns an HTML layout based on provided properties and children elements, incorporating navigation, header, main content, and footer.
